interface.title: RAPTOR Dashboard v2.2.2 (RNA-seq Analysis Pipeline)
interface.stage_of_work: Data quality control, picking a DE method, and combining and tuning DE results produced outside the tool
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a count matrix and sample metadata, check sample quality and profile the data, get a DE pipeline recommendation, then import DESeq2/edgeR/limma results to compare them, tune significance thresholds, and build a consensus.

data.note: counts.csv (200 genes x 40 samples) and metadata.csv (40 samples, condition and batch) were uploaded on the Quality page. deseq2_results.csv, edger_results.csv and limma_results.csv (60 genes each) were uploaded on Import DE. Session state carried data from Quality to Profiler to Recommender and from Import DE to Optimization and Ensemble. Downloads collected: filtered_counts.csv and qc_report.json.

screens_never_reached: Data Acquisition page (public data search, dataset pooling, metadata editing): not visited on purpose, because the notes warn of import errors with no internet and missing optional packages; accepted as a known gap
Biomarker Discovery (Module 10): not visited within the ~100-action budget, although its default selectors (univariate filter, Elastic Net, RFE) should work offline
Reports, Settings and Visualization pages: not visited within the ~100-action budget
Ensemble methods Voting and Weighted: labelled 'Coming Soon … being upgraded' and not offered as options
ML-Based Recommender mode: 'No trained model' (it needs the CLI raptor train-ml-recommender), so only Rule-Based Only was selectable

A non-empty Ensemble result (tiers, P-values chart, consensus gene table, All Consensus Genes filter by Tier and Direction, Tier 1/Up/Down export): never reached, because Fisher's and Brown's errored and RRA returned 0 genes
not_done: Combine DE results into a consensus call: Fisher's (screens/058–059) and Brown's (screens/055–056) both failed with 'All values in ps must lie between 0. and 1.'. Retries also failed the same way: with 2 methods (DESeq2+edgeR, screens/064–065) and with 'Require same direction' unticked (screens/066–067); 'Apply pre-filters' was ticked and unticked without running (screens/054). RRA ran but found 0 consensus genes. The reviewer traces the failure to an all-NaN gene in the run's synthetic DE files: its combined p-value is NaN and scipy's false_discovery_control rejects NaN (raptor/ensemble.py:517-518). This is a tool robustness bug (no NaN handling), not evidence that the step cannot be done; no consensus gene list was produced in this run.
Voting and Weighted ensemble methods are not available in this build ('Coming Soon').

Save Optimized Parameters on the Optimization page showed a KeyError traceback (st.session_state has no key 'm8_optimized_params'), both before and after pressing it (screens/078), so it is unclear whether the optimized thresholds were handed on to Ensemble.
Other threshold-search criteria (Stability, Reproducibility, Ground Truth): only FDR Control was run, because of the action budget. The other options in the method dropdown were not opened.
Export a consensus gene list and a publication-ready report: there was no consensus list to export, and the Reports page was not visited.
Batch effects: the QC report JSON says no significant batch effect was detected (an F statistic for condition only). No dedicated batch-effect panel was seen on screen.

Filtered data hand-off: the Profiler says it uses 'quality-filtered data from Module 2' but still reports 40 samples. In the replay (threshold 2, 5 outliers, filtered_counts.csv with 35 columns) it also showed 40, so the outliers are not actually removed before profiling.

Replay coverage: the replay hit its ~60-action limit, so t6–t12 and f2–f8 remain unconfirmed. In the replay, choosing 3D on the PCA Plot did not stick: each setting change reran the page and reset the tabs to Library Sizes, leaving the plot in 2D.

Also not tried because of the action budget: the alternative 10-sample small_counts dataset, the cpm/quantile normalizations, the Expression Distribution / RLE / Mean-Variance QC tabs, and the Profiler Gene Detection / Mean-Variance tabs.
